一晚房钱只要八十文，不知您意下如何？: The room rate is only eighty wen per night. What do you think?
一本由未署名作者所著的道家典籍，主要是针对三清诸尊的论述，其看法颇多独到之处。: A Taoist classic written by an uncredited author, mainly focusing on discussions of the Three Pure Ones, with many unique perspectives.
一束小心的被放在黄纸包中的头发，散发着常人无法看到的邪气，似乎是为了某种目的而特: A lock of hair carefully placed in a yellow paper bundle exuded an evil aura invisible to ordinary people, seemingly a specially crafted cursed charm for some purpose.
一束用红线和黄纸包起来的头发？\n莫非这就是侵扰小红姑娘的邪厉根源…:
A lock of hair wrapped in red thread and yellow paper?
Could this be the source of the evil and fierce affliction that has troubled Miss Xiaohong...
一来向方师伯交代我们之后碰上的…遭遇，\n二来让他知道我们最后平安无事离开，以免:
First, after explaining to Uncle Fang, we encountered... Encountering each other,
Second, to let him know we left safely in the end, so he wouldn't worry about us,
Only then would I not lose the proper respect befitting a junior.
一来让她不再担心受怕，二来那朱敕占据这洞府多日，\n想必四处弄乱了不少地方，还得:
First, it relieved her worry; second, Zhu Chi had occupied this cave residence for many days,
She must have messed up quite a few places and still had to clean up the mess.
一柄做工极为细致，看来气势非凡的古式长剑，不过剑身伤痕累累，似乎被其主人毫不爱惜: An ancient longsword, exquisitely crafted and seemingly imposing, was battered and scarred, seemingly used carelessly by its owner, and discarded once it was no longer usable.
一柄式样粗犷独特、一望即知并非凡间之物的长剑，原本被安放在云龙山顶一处由奇特封界: A rugged and uniquely shaped longsword, clearly not of the mortal realm, was originally placed in a blackstone cave atop Mount Yunlong guarded by the peculiar The Sealed Realm, later acquired by Shen Wuming.
一柄轻薄锋锐、泛着碧绿光泽的长剑，是虞莹的师父送给她的离别礼物，也是她从不离身的: A thin, sharp, emerald-green long sword was a farewell gift from Yu Ying's master, and also her companion sword that never left her side. When she wielded this sword with unparalleled speed, it was indeed like a willow leaf soaring in the wind.
一柄黑色匕首深深刺入她的胸口，周围满是鲜血，\n脸孔上还留着有如传说的地狱恶鬼般:
A black dagger stabbed deep into her chest, surrounded by blood,
His face still bore a twisted expression as terrifying as the legendary hellish demons,
Xiaohong lay unconscious in the pool of blood nearby, but fortunately, she was unharmed.
一波又平一波又起，众人正与公输彻把酒言欢时，突然遇到一名叫许二娘的路过妇人控诉崆: One wave calmed down, the next one rose. While everyone was drinking and chatting with Gongshu Che, they suddenly encountered a passing woman named Xu Erniang, who accused the Kongtong Sect of taking money without doing business. Since the matter concerned the Sect's reputation, Shen Zijun decided to go to the Cheng family compound first to inform Yang Yunshu about the matter.
一点反应都没有…看来需要什么方式让它启动…: No reaction at all... It seems some kind of way is needed to get it started...
一点小伤而已。事情的经过是这样的，: Just a minor injury. Here's what happened,
一点都不好，他摔伤了腿不能快步行走，\n然后又有那鬼东西守在外面不走，\n你们来:
Not good at all—he injured his leg and couldn't walk quickly,
Then there was that ghostly thing guarding outside and refusing to leave,
You came here to save people, but I'm afraid you won't be able to get out either.
一直到现在，我还是想不出她可能遇上了什么事…: Even now, I still can't figure out what might have happened to her...
一种只生长于阴暗处的奇特蕨类，据说有某种独特的药效，但由于使用方法极为繁复，只有: A peculiar fern that grows only in shady places, it is said to have a unique medicinal effect, but due to its extremely complicated usage, only a very few people use it as a medicinal herb.
一种可见于长兴村岩壁高处的稀有药草，据说一天之内发芽开花，在日落之后便即凋萎消失: A rare herb found on the cliffs of Changxing Village, said to sprout and bloom within a day, but wither and disappear after sunset, making it extremely hard to find. It has the unique properties of dispersing qi and transforming energy, making it a lifesaver for those who suffer internal energy misfire.
一种品种特殊的罕见芷花，具有半透明如冰的奇特花瓣，据说它只生长于最接近天的云中高: A rare variety of Zhihua has unique, ice-transparent petals. It is said to grow only on the high peaks closest to the sky, absorbing the spiritual mist from the clouds, and possesses miraculous properties that harmonize various medicinal properties.
一种早已绝迹多年的希罕银叶杏树的果实，据说三十年才会开花，结出的果实透明如冰，其: A rare ginkgo-leaf apricot tree fruit that has long been extinct is said to bloom only after thirty years. The fruit is crystal-clear as ice, but inside grows bright red blood, with miraculous effects of restoring the soul, extending life, and regenerating internal organs.
一种生长于终年不见天日之地，遇到阳光随即融化消失的神秘兰花，通体透明如晶，据说是: A mysterious orchid that grows in places where sunlight never sits all year round and melts away when exposed to sunlight. Its entire body is transparent like crystal, said to be born by absorbing the evil yin energy from underground, hence also called the 'Yellow Springs Flower.' It contains a powerful poison of yin and evil energy.
一种生长在水潭边的黑绿色长草，茎叶中充满一种会发出独特气味的黏液，据说榨出汁液后: A type of dark green grass growing by ponds, its stems and leaves filled with a mucus that emits a distinctive smell. It is said that the juice extracted can be used to repel insects.
一种非常罕见的灵芝，通体呈半透明紫色，因形状多变且边缘处呈白色而得云芝之名。不但: A very rare type of lingzhi mushroom, its entire body is semi-transparent purple. It is named Yun Zhi for its ever-changing shape and white edges. Not only does it have the effect of reviving the dead, but it can also harmonize the conflicts between various medicinal properties, making it one of the most highly prized medicinal materials.
一经入体后，沿血行慢慢上到心脉附近发作，\n令中毒者全身冰冷、心萎脉缩，慢慢僵硬:
Once it enters the body, it slowly ascends along the blood flow to the area near the heart vessel,
causing the poisoned person's whole body to feel cold, heart to atrophy and vessels to contract, gradually stiffening and weakening until death,
It is a sinister, cunning, and extremely hard-to-treat poison technique.
一统人世、开创太平新纪的梦想…么？: The dream of unifying the world and ushering in a new era of peace... Huh?
一行人一出下水道入口，走没两步就碰上了正奉命四处寻找他们的高府门卫，得知高处恭老: As soon as the group exited the sewer entrance, they barely took a few steps when they encountered the gatekeeper of the Gao residence, who was ordered to search everywhere. Upon learning that General Gao Chugong was eager to find out the details of the investigation, the group headed to the backyard of the Gao residence.
一行人一路打倒防范闯入者的丁甲咒符，终于通过丁谓设下的遁甲乱阵来到位在高耸入云之: The group defeats the Ding Jia Talisman to guard against intruders, and finally uses the Dunjia Chaos Formation set by Ding Wei to reach the rooftop of the study towering into the clouds. Everyone is amazed by Ding Wei's hidden knowledge and audacious actions. However, the destroyed Shiftstep array on the ground can no longer track the user's whereabouts, so they have no choice but to search the study for other clues...
一行人万万没想到会遭了周衢与朱豫连手暗算，被骗入原本慕容宽用来诱杀对手的致命机关: The group never expected to be ambushed by Zhou Qu and Zhu Yu in a joint attack, tricked into the deadly trap that Murong Kuan had originally used to lure and kill his opponents. Perhaps by fate, Shen Zijun, separated from his companions again due to the trap, encountered Xiao Yin, who had suffered the same fate. The two temporarily turned enemies into friends and teamed up to break through this death dungeon said to have survived from the dead...
一行人与朱豫约好连手合作，朱豫伺机而动施法压制邪气，一行人则须全力打倒黑邪鬼。: The group agrees with Zhu Yu to work together. Zhu Yu waits for the right moment to cast spells to suppress the evil energy, while the group must do their utmost to defeat the Black Fell Ghost.
一行人从文炳清口中得知其女文熙月失踪的大略经过后，决定前往开封府向判官梁恕询问案: After learning from Wen Bingqing the general account of their daughter Wen Xiyue's disappearance, the group decided to go to Kaifeng Prefecture to inquire about the case with Judge Liang Shu.
一行人从王定手中得到疑似开封下水道的钥匙，然而还得靠机关高手来找出入口，于是一行: The group receives what appears to be the key to the sealed sewer from Wang Ding, but still needs a skilled mechanic to find the entrance. So they head to the Iron Scrap Building Hotel to find Gongshu Che for help...
一行人从矾楼的简掌柜得知中书省官员文炳清的爱女神秘失踪，决定找到他问个清楚。: The group learned from Manager Jian of the Fan Tower that the beloved daughter of Wen Bingqing, an official of the Central Secretariat, had mysteriously gone missing and decided to find him to get the answer.
一行人从郭家宅院救出了皇甫硕，并让他与封灵瑄暂时住到灵音庵，然而自称孙倚凤的道姑: The group rescues Huangfu Shuo from the Guo family estate and lets him and Feng Lingxuan temporarily stay at Lingyin Nunnery. However, a Taoist nun claiming to be Sun Yifeng comes to inquire about Dian Zhu's whereabouts, so the group heads to Wuhuan Valley north of Hanyang.
一行人从隐界回到了熟悉的人间，在感觉恍如隔世之际，申子隽想起了当初在千钧一发之际: The group returned from The Hidden Realm to the familiar human world. Feeling as if in a lifetime, Shen Zijun recalled escaping Bichao Palace at the last moment from the moment when it was about to be destroyed by the power of the Water Pearl. Worried about whether Hangzhou would survive this disaster, he decided to hurry back to see for himself.
一行人从韩璘沙口中得知惊人的消息，满怀恨意的青面蛟王得知韩璘沙反叛，竟然决定掀起: The group learned shocking news from Han Linsha: the hateful Green-Faced Jiao King learned of Han Linsha's rebellion and decided to unleash a storm to destroy Hangzhou. Although Han Linsha knew how to enter the underwater palace where he was, the group first needed to find a boatman brave enough to sail in the fierce wind...
一行人从高处恭处得知玉清昭应宫在夜里遇袭的消息，他们决定先找到文炳清告知文熙月宿: The group learned from Gao Chugong that the Yuqing Zhaoying Palace had been attacked during the night. They decided to first find Wen Bingqing to inform Wen Xiyue of the good news that her chronic illness had been cured, and tried to contact Prime Minister Ding Wei through him.
一行人从高奉手中救回胡天德后，发现他原来是出于一片好意，于是代替他将契约带回金华: After rescuing Hu Tiande from Gao Feng, the group realized he had good intentions, so they took the contract back to Jinhua Pavilion on his behalf and explained the situation to Lady Bai.
一行人再次找到了等在旷野中的魔眼使者，这回的战斗比先前的更为艰苦，不过申子隽一行: The group once again found the Demon-Eye Envoy waiting in the wilderness. This time, the battle was even tougher than before, but Shen Zijun and his group still emerged victorious. According to Demon-Eye Envoy, one more victory and defeat are needed to fully lift the curse of the Demon-Eye Eye.
一行人击败负责断后的庞伥与于妩，得知萧茵独自前往「太乙三枢座」，于是继续从后追赶: The group defeated Pang Chang and Yu Wu, who were in charge of covering the rear, and learned that Xiao Yin had gone alone to the 'Taiyi Three Pivots,' so they continued to pursue from behind.
一行人刚出来就碰上正在四处寻找他们的高府门卫，于是前往高府后院向老将军说明经过。: As soon as the group came out, they encountered the gatekeepers of the Gao residence searching everywhere, so they went to the backyard of the Gao residence to explain the situation to the old general.
一行人刚进胡记质库就遇上了一桩奇异的纠纷，淳于宿认出被不识货的詹掌事丢在地上的石: As soon as the group enters Hu's Pawnshop, they encounter a strange dispute. Chunyu Su recognizes that the stone tray thrown on the ground by the unrecognizable Steward Zhan is actually a Taoist treasure. As the dispute breaks out, a ransom letter from the warehouse owner Hu Tiande arrives, demanding hostages. The group then turns to help rescue Hu Tiande...
一行人发现巨虫「地蠋」在山腹里面挖出了一个错综复杂的巨大迷宫，而若想继续深入这个: The group discovers that the giant insect "Earthgrub" has dug a complex and massive maze deep within the mountain. To continue deeper into this maze, they must use Earthgrub itself to open a passage, which requires preparing appropriate tools...
一行人向在场坐镇指挥的三位掌门打过招呼后，申子隽打算趁机将朱豫之前的所为告诉褚道: After greeting the three sect leaders stationed at the scene, Shen Zijun planned to take the opportunity to tell Chu Daoquan about Zhu Yu's previous actions.
一行人在一场血战之后终于打倒了严黑虎。正好赶上最后一幕的郸厉从他的尸身将魔腑收回: After a bloody battle, the group finally defeated Yan Heihu. Dan Li, who happened to catch the final scene, retrieved the demonic organs from his corpse and told him he had successfully cured Wen Xiyue's illness and would send her home before he and Qi Wujiang left Kaifeng. After Dan Li left, the group, having solved two problems at once, could finally say goodbye to the underground ruins and return to the sunshine and breeze of Kaifeng...
一行人在丁谓书房找到的古怪钥匙，这柄满是刮痕与锈斑的粗大钥匙似乎曾在地下埋了一段: The group found a strange key in Ding Wei's study. This thick, scratch-stained and rust-stained key seemed to have been buried underground for some time, and judging by its complex design, it was likely used to open some extremely important door.
一行人在即将闯进怪异盗匪的巢窟时为一道机关门所阻，只好回头另觅途径。: As the group was about to break into the lair of strange bandits, they were blocked by a mechanism door and had to turn back to find another route.
一行人在同轩客栈前撞见朱豫仗着崆峒派之名作威作福，于是前往神武观向褚道全告知此事: The group ran into Zhu Yu in front of Tongxuan Inn using the Kongtong Sect's name to act arrogantly, so they went to Shenwu Temple to inform Chu Daoquan about it.
一行人在城郊凑巧救了遇袭的皇城司察举王定，一起抵达开封之后，一行人便前往高将军府: The group happened to rescue Wang Ding, a Inspector from the Imperial City Command, who was under attack on the outskirts of the city. After arriving in Kaifeng, they headed to General Gao's residence.
一行人在开封府找到了判官梁恕，然而他表示自己最近忙于其他公务，无暇到开封街头进行: The group found Judge Liang Shu in Kaifeng Prefecture, but he said he was recently busy with other official duties and had no time to conduct inquiries on the streets of Kaifeng, and asked everyone to watch for any suspicious activities in the marketplace.
一行人在开封府找到了梁恕，但他手头并没有什么情报，一行人必须自己到外头打听消息。: The group found Liang Shu in Kaifeng Prefecture, but he had no intelligence on hand, so they had to go outside and gather information themselves.
一行人在新开启的领域中遇上了另一种行尸，显然是出于一名尸魔术大师之手，一行人决定: In a newly opened domain, the group encounters another type of walking corpse, apparently the work of a master of corpse magic. They decide to go and see the true face of this master.
一行人在瘴神谷的洞穴前遇到了左玄与秦承纲，即使修为如他这般高强之人也有忌讳之物，: The group encountered Zuo Xuan and Qin Chenggang in front of the cave in Zhangshen Valley. Even someone as powerful as him had taboos, so Shen Zijun agreed to enter the cave and tried to suppress the oppressive evil yin blood energy with the "Miasma-Repelling Immortal Talisman." He then defeated the spider demon "Nine-Miasma Bonefiend," which had used this place as a lair and harmed countless people.
一行人在神武观门口遇上正好受命去找申子隽的李鸿轩，于是他在房里向褚道全、穆元钧两: At the entrance of Shenwu Temple, the group encounters Li Hongxuan, who happens to be sent to find Shen Zijun. In his room, he tells the two sect leaders, Chu Daoquan and Mu Yuanjun, everything from Wuming Valley to the present, and he holds nothing back about his connections with Shen Wuming and Bajian. This long conversation lasts until dawn in the next morning, until news of Xiao Yin's group breaking into the treasure vault interrupts...
一行人在钱塘江上游发现了一处偏远隐蔽的江边林地，虽然这里看来风景明秀，晏兰卿与淳: The group discovered a remote and hidden riverside woodland upstream of the Qiantang River. Although the scenery seemed beautiful, Yan Lanqing and Chunyu Su caught an ominous scent of evil blood in the wind, making it seem worth a thorough investigation...
一行人在钱塘江发现一处飘着精怪腥气的江边林地，决定好好在此进行一番探索。: The group discovered a riverside woodland by the Qiantang River filled with a strange and fishy smell, and decided to explore it thoroughly.
一行人在霄云之间追上了百里晟，无法开启霄云之门返回天界的他在狂怒之下转而与一行人: The group caught up with Baili Sheng among the clouds. Unable to open the Gate of Clouds and return to the Heavenly Realm, he turned to battle the group in a rage. Even though he revealed the true form of Heavenly General Yi and risked everything, he was ultimately defeated and his soul destroyed. Ou Yezi then appeared and used his remnants to complete the Overlord Sword. Behind that 'Xiaoyun Gate,' the final chapter of destiny awaited Shen Zijun...
一行人在龟山凉亭找到了封灵瑄。得知她与三师兄皇甫硕身份非凡后，一行人前往胡记质库: The group found Feng Lingxuan at the Guishan Pavilion. After learning that she and Third Senior Brother Huangfu Shuo had extraordinary identities, the group went to Hu Ji Zhi Ku to ask Steward Zhan about the origin of the Eight Sundial Cloud Disk.
一行人奋力击败了等在旷野中一处林地里的魔眼使者，不过一次胜利还不足以解除魔眼的诅: The group fought hard to defeat the Demon-Eye Envoy waiting in a woodland in the wilderness, but a single victory was not enough to lift the curse of the Demon-Eye Envoy. After he vanished into black mist, Shen Zijun had to wait for the Demon-Eye Envoy's next call.
一行人意外的遇上了熟面孔，策划绑架胡天德的居然是之前在紫竹林落荒而逃的高奉，众人: The group unexpectedly encounters a familiar face. The person who planned Hu Tiande's kidnapping is actually Gao Feng, who had previously fled in Zizhu Grove. After defeating him again and rescuing Hu Tiande from Hu's Pawnshop, they finally learn the whole story from him. Happy that the matter has been resolved, the group heads to Jinhua Pavilion to deliver the good news to Lady Bai.
一行人打倒了无忧洞主黄义，并从他口中得知地下更深处有恐怖的存在，而通往该处的入口: The group defeated Wuyou Cave master Huang Yi and learned from him that there was a terrifying presence deeper underground, with the entrance to it just behind a hole in the brick wall.
一行人找到躲在房里的猫精金穗儿，从她手中取得破解邪法的太常仙印后，继续往前寻找敌: The group finds the cat spirit Jin Sui'er hiding in the room. After obtaining the Taichang Immortal Seal that breaks the evil spell from her, they continue searching for the enemy and the whereabouts of the poison elimination.
一行人护送车夫与货车平安回到杭州城，车上的货物已被卸放在货栈处等待清点，就等着申: The group escorted the coachman and the truck safely back to Hangzhou. The goods on the cart had already been unloaded at the warehouse awaiting counting, just waiting for Shen Zijun to deliver the good news to Zhao Siduan.
一行人搭上官船，由杭州沿着运河一路追踪韩璘沙的踪迹到太湖之中，在淳于宿的指引下穿: The group boarded an official boat, traveling from Hangzhou along the canal to trace Han Linsha's trail into Taihu Lake. Guided by Chunyu Su, they passed through the dense mist and maze on the lake to reach the Ghost Dragon Gang's water fortress. Leaving the official boat and Lu Jun to wait at the dock, the group broke into the mist-shrouded water fortress to search for traces of Han Linsha...
一行人救出牢房里的翠香后随即遇上了熟人庞伥，在一场激战击败他之后于娬与萧茵跟着出: After rescuing Cuixiang from the cell, the group immediately encounters their acquaintance Pang Chang. After a fierce battle and defeating him, Yu Wu and Xiao Yin appear, but Xiao Yin seems determined not to linger and immediately casts a Shiftstep spell to leave. After rescuing Cuixiang and returning to the Iron Chip Building Hotel, the group went to the Imperial City Office to report to Wang Ding that the Shen family was indeed harboring Liao forces.
一行人果然在地窖牢房里找到了翠香，在萧茵带着于妩与被打败的庞伥离去后，一行人将她: Sure enough, the group found Cuixiang in the cellar. After Xiao Yin left with Yu Wu and the defeated Pang Chang, they rescued her and brought her back to the Iron Scrap Tower Hotel, then went to the Imperial City Division to report to Wang Ding about the Shen family's collusion with foreign enemies.
一行人终于在房间里面等到亥时，根据晏兰卿的占卜，此刻可以在之前找到的三株大树聚生: The group finally waited in the room until the hour of Hai. According to Yan Lanqing's divination, they could find the wine thief at the place where three large trees had gathered earlier, so the group set off there full of curiosity.
一行人终于在鬼龙寨的最深处找到了韩璘沙，然而在一场激战之后，她以赵四端的性命与说: The group finally found Han Linsha deep within Ghost Dragon Village. After a fierce battle, she demanded cooperation on the condition of Zhao Siduan's life and revealing the truth about the mastermind. Shen Zijun accepted her terms, and they agreed to meet at the Guanchao Pavilion in Hangzhou. The group then returned to the official ship's berth to prepare to leave.
一行人终于来到这洞府中最深处的九应炼神炉，却惊见点朱在天火中焚烧的众人打倒主导此: The group finally arrived at the deepest part of the cave, the Nine Responses Divine Refining Furnace, only to be shocked to see Dian Zhu burning everyone in heavenly fire and defeating the evil leader Zhu Chi. Only then did they realize he had risked using heavenly fire to try to remove the seal on her. It was revealed that Dian Zhu's true identity was actually a descendant of Vermilion Bird. Sun Yifeng took her back to the mountain to recuperate, while the group went to inform Jin Sui'er that they had reclaimed the cave dwelling...
一行人终于进入了外号无忧洞的开封地下水道，准备探勘这处位在大宋都城底下的阴暗迷宫: The group finally entered the Kaifeng underground waterway, nicknamed Wuyou Cave, preparing to explore this dark maze beneath the capital of the Song Dynasty.
一行人经由神秘的「隐界之门」回到了熟悉的钱塘江上游江边林地，申子隽在心中回味这段: The group traveled through the mysterious 'Gate of the Hidden Realm' back to the familiar woodlands along the upper reaches of the Qiantang River. While reminiscing about this dreamlike journey, Shen Zijun also remembered the eight words: 'Only Heaven bestows the mandate, on the sunny side of Han.' After returning to Hangzhou and confirming everything was calm, he headed to Hanyang...
一行人被晏兰卿引动的法阵移遁到一处未知的地下空间，这个充满远古气息的巨大秘道似乎: The group was shiftstepped into an unknown underground space by the formation activated by Yan Lanqing. Young man, if you have the problem of having trouble sleeping at night like I do,

Young man, if you want to eat and drink in Hanyang,

Young man, I can tell at a glance that you're a quick-tempered person,

小伙子，我在看过天玄、紫云等几个著名剑派配剑的方式，\n未曾看过像你这样的，你的:

Young man, welcome to Xiangyang, the strongest city in the world,
Here, our Xiangyang Prefecture office and the imperial guards are stationed, along with the city walls as solid as an impregnable fortress,
We will never allow the enemy or the enemy to cross the line.

Young man, it seems you are as passionate about the art of swordsmanship as I am,

After exiting the east gate of the village, turn left to find the stone steps among the rocks,

Something incredible happened recently...

If you have anything to do, I can offer you some guidance.

I believe this book will surely help me grasp the secrets of crafting weapons,
Let me forge a fine weapon as a token of my gratitude.

我楞了一下之后，不知哪来的胆量转身追过去看，\n只见那烟雾从桥边沿着河道往下，像:

refers to the bright moon reflected on the pond surface at night, and the jade bracelet at the bottom of the pond that is hard to notice,

causing her own brother to suffer an unjust injustice, and in the end, to escape prison with unknown fate
